notes: New look and navigation: a flat, neutral "Workbench" style (white page in the light theme, thin lines, one blue accent, line icons) and no animated backgrounds. Home has round buttons for Submit, Jobs, Files and Cluster that settle into a left rail on the other pages; Software now lives inside Cluster and storage inside Files. The window has its own top row with the menus and the window buttons, and keeps Windows moving, resizing and snapping. Guided tour rewritten in seven sections, with a spotlight on the control being explained; the Submit section walks through every field of the job form. This is the first release with its own window frame: if moving or resizing misbehaves on your screen, please tell us. Not code-signed yet.
